title: towards sustainable cultural-tourism integration in china’s ethnic regions – models, challenges, and policy strategies
core_idea: Examine six culture–tourism integration models organized in a 2×3 matrix (concept-based: promotion and substitution; product-based; market-based), using comparative case studies across Naxi, Miao, Zhuang, She, Qiang, and Tibetan regions to assess model applicability, explore systemic, resource, and market challenges to integration, and propose targeted policy strategies for sustainable integration (innovation enhancement, industry restructuring, cultural-economic balancing, institutional reform).
tldr: Analyzes six models in a 2×3 framework for integrating culture and tourism in China's ethnic regions, explores contextual challenges, and outlines policy strategy directions for sustainable integration.
